Class TakeMoneyAction

java.lang.Object
io.github.kaivian.klibrary.action.impl.AbstractAction
io.github.kaivian.klibrary.action.impl.actions.TakeMoneyAction
All Implemented Interfaces:
Action
public class TakeMoneyAction extends AbstractAction
Withdraws money from the target player's account via Vault.

If Vault is not installed, the action is skipped with a warning.

YAML configuration:

type: take_money
amount: 50.0
